facts.text: Gastrulation is the week-3 process that forms the three germ layers: ectoderm, mesoderm and endoderm.
Epiblast cells move toward the streak, let go of their neighbours and slip underneath (invagination).
The book has the definitive notochord forming head-first; human specimens show it first forms in the middle and spreads both ways.
Beyond Langman: human CS7 data show epiblast, streak, new mesoderm, endoderm and primordial germ cells side by side.
Gastrulation opens the period most sensitive to teratogens, weeks 3 to 8.
